$comment: Reviewed provider overrides for the Windows FFmpeg build-input closure (#236).
A virtual %PROVIDES% name with two or more COMPATIBLE providers stops the
resolution; it can only be resolved here, by a human naming the virtual, the
real package and the version constraint the decision applies to.
An override that is missing, stale, incompatible, unused or names something
unknown fails the resolution -- see negative-controls.py.
This list is EMPTY on purpose: the reviewed closure of 246 packages contains
no ambiguous virtual dependency. It is not a placeholder for future entries;
if one ever becomes necessary, adding it is a reviewed change to the lock.
